title: What is a zero-click attack and how does it hack your phone without touching anything?
content_md:
What is a zero-click attack and how does it hack your phone without touching anything? Zero-click attacks exploit vulnerabilities in messaging apps, phone firmware, or other services that process data automatically. The target never needs to click a link or open an attachment.

via Mastodon https://donporque.com/que-es-un-ataque-zero-click-y-como-funciona/
exclude_reason: Generic Spanish explainer about zero-click attacks, not reporting a new incident
